description: Source code for FreeType library functions related to glyph synthesis, including oblique and embolden transformations for font glyphs.

methods.name: FT_GlyphSlot_Oblique
methods.description: Applies an oblique (slant) transformation to a glyph outline.

methods.name: FT_GlyphSlot_Embolden
methods.description: Embosses (emboldens) a glyph, either by transforming its outline or bitmap.
